# Spotify App Review Analysis: Next-Quarter Priority

## Recommendation

Put next quarter's product effort into **usability**. It is the largest specific topic, with 13163 complaint/cancellation reviews and a severity sum of 33278 [F14, F15]. Fix `usability.ad_frequency` first, then the core listening controls: `usability.playback_controls_limited` and `usability.shuffle_control`. The largest single specific issue, `billing.features_locked_behind_premium`, overlaps heavily with the controls problem, so the controls work should be scoped together with whoever owns free-tier packaging.

## Evidence

- **`usability.ad_frequency`**: This issue has 5488 complaints [C09], a severity sum of 11849 [C10] and mean severity 2.159074 [C11]. It covers too many ads, ads that play too often, and ad breaks that run too long. One customer describes a safety concern: "Today I almost got into an accident because of unexpected loud ad music" (08a1f178-3e7a-4d65-9da3-dee293dd0061).

- **`billing.features_locked_behind_premium`**: This is the top-ranked specific issue, with 4490 complaints [C05], severity sum 13442 [C06] and mean severity 2.993764 [C07]. Customers say skipping, repeating and seeking now require Premium. Examples:
  - "I can only 6 skip 6 stacks per hour now I can't play a song which i searched up everything is removed you need premium to do anything I am planning on switching to yt music instead of this now" (a0d2ccd3-ebb3-46b9-bbf7-212bb0ec8e84). This is cancellation intent, not a confirmed departure.
  - "it has started charging money for even playing the playlist normally" (33a171b5-b930-48c3-8560-97b8deb538be).

- **`usability.playback_controls_limited`**: This issue has 1592 complaints [C17], severity sum 4797 [C18] and mean severity 3.013191 [C19]. Customers describe being unable to skip back, seek or repeat: "The new update is so bad I can't even swith the previous song back and I can't even listen to my playlist." (9a2f9235-5c31-4726-baf5-dbb5910e345c).

- **`usability.shuffle_control`**: This issue has 1679 complaints [C21], severity sum 4787 [C22] and mean severity 2.851102 [C23]. It covers shuffle that cannot be turned off or plays songs in an unwanted order.

- **`usability.queue_playlist_management`**: This adds 1357 complaints [C25] with severity sum 4121 [C26].

The highest-ranked issue overall is the catch-all `other.general`, with 14039 complaints [C01] and severity sum 28433 [C02]. These complaints name no specific defect, so they cannot direct a fix. `usability.general` (1862 complaints [C13]) is also a catch-all.

## Alternatives considered

- **Billing/support**: Billing has 6875 complaint/cancellation reviews and severity sum 20158 [F18, F19]. Support adds only 118 reviews with severity sum 362 [F28, F29].
  - Billing's top issue is real and large. However, it is a free-versus-Premium packaging decision rather than a defect fix.
  - This analysis has no revenue or plan-tier data, so it cannot judge the trade-off of unlocking features.
  - `billing.general` (1496 complaints [C33]) is a catch-all.
  - If leadership is willing to revisit free-tier limits, billing could share priority with usability.
- **Playback**: Playback has 5615 reviews and severity sum 18451 [F20, F21].
  - `playback.app_crashes_freezes` has the highest mean severity of any ranked issue, at 3.501724 [C31]. Its volume is smaller, with 1160 complaints [C29] and severity sum 4062 [C30].
  - `playback.general` (1222 complaints [C37]) is a catch-all.
  - Crash telemetry showing wider impact than reviews suggest would raise playback's priority.
- **Access**: Access has only 1610 reviews and severity sum 6291 [F22, F23]. That is the smallest of the candidate areas apart from support, so it ranks lowest.

## Limits

- **Review data**:
  - App reviews are self-selected and historical. They are not a representative user survey.
  - There is no revenue, plan tier or confirmed churn data.
  - The 4327 cancellation-intent reviews [F06] show stated intent, not actual cancellations.
- **Classification scope**:
  - Classification covered a seeded random sample [F00]. It included 100000 completed reviews [F02] out of 660622 source reviews [F01].
  - 560609 reviews were outside the scope [F99]. All counts above describe the classified sample only.
  - 13 reviews were quarantined for empty text [F03], and 0 for other failures [F04].
- **Needs-review flag**: 13974 completed reviews were flagged needs_review [F07]. These are included in every count and ranking; the flag only marks them for human inspection.
- **Concentration in top issues**: The top three issues hold 53.9 percent of ranked complaint memberships [F09]. That share includes the `other.general` catch-all.
- **Verification**: A second model checked a 1000-text sample [F10].
  - Topic agreement was 84.6 percent [F11] and intent agreement was 91.2 percent [F12].
  - Severity differed by a mean of 0.155 levels [F13].
  - These figures measure agreement between two models, not accuracy.
